title: Almost integral elements (Stacks 00GW)
statement: Let $R$ be an integral domain with field of fractions $K$. An element $g\in K$ is \emph{almost integral over $R$} if there exists $r\in R$, $r\neq0$, such that $rg^n\in R$ for all integers $n\geq0$.
